contributions.scopeNote: The disc is billed “Marek Weber und sein Orchester”, naming him at the head of the band; the orchestra is recorded separately as the performing body. Accompanied Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender; the Jube Pops reissue credits the Marek Weber Orchestra under his direction.
Recorded the song; the ensemble is named on the disc as “Marek Weber und sein Orchester”.

Recorded the song with the Marek Weber Orchestra; the recording is published on the Jube Pops compilation of Walter Jurmann’s film songs. He also played the lead in Der glückliche Herr Fünf, the film the song comes from, as the trade advertisement announces.
